# .NET Version Upgrade Progress

## Overview

This workflow upgrades ArkanePsh projects to .NET 10 with a compatibility-first all-at-once strategy. Work starts with SDK prechecks, then project retargeting, compatibility fixes, and final validation.

**Progress**: 4/4 tasks complete (100%) ![100%](https://progress-bar.xyz/100)

## Tasks

- ✅ 01-prerequisites: Validate SDK and upgrade preconditions
- ✅ 02-project-targeting: Retarget project frameworks to net10.0-compatible settings
- ✅ 03-compatibility-fixes: Resolve upgrade-related build and configuration issues
- ✅ 04-validation: Validate build and tests on upgraded targets
